title: ROAT Observatory: how law lets automated vehicles onto the road
description: Comparative models of automated-vehicle deployment governance — layered regulatory normalisation (N0–N4), post-type-approval deployment models (the Second Gate), human roles and the ROAT regulatory method — published as coded, provenance-tracked datasets at dated snapshots from the ROAT Intelligence Hub, with a Source Library of verified primary sources and defined concepts. Site: https://jozefandrasko-creator.github.io/roat-observatory/ . Faculty of Law, Comenius University Bratislava (ROAT); supported by project APVV-23-0519. Data CC BY 4.0, code MIT.
